Clarify the smallest supported schema/process representation when commissioning; do not invent unsupported Spacedock frontmatter or a third production workflow just for variants.
2. Publication uses the exact accepted package and separate applicable user authority. Model defects discovered during instruction review route back to a linked model revision; plan/view/text fixes remain in instruction work. Several instruction editions can share one model revision. Modeling does not require instruction generation.
A set is the long-lived repository identity. Candidate iterations are revision artifacts, not a task per image. Branches/worktrees provide temporary execution isolation for entities; no permanent model branch/instruction branch. Reusable tool fixes belong in StudFleet's existing dev workflow, linked as dependencies, not hidden in this set repository.
